name: Semgrep
summary: Application security platform for code scanning (SAST), dependencies (SCA) and secrets, with AI triage.
description: Semgrep scans source code for security issues with its SAST engine, checks open-source dependencies for vulnerabilities and malware, and detects hardcoded secrets. AI features help triage and fix findings. The scanning engine is open source. A free edition with cross-file analysis is available for small teams, and paid plans are priced per contributor per month. The company runs a programme for teams moving from Checkmarx or Snyk.

howToUse.title: Open Semgrep
howToUse.description: Open Semgrep and sign in. The scanning engine is open source. Run it so Semgrep scans source code for security issues with the SAST engine.

howToUse.title: Check dependencies and secrets
howToUse.description: Run the supply-chain checks. Semgrep checks open-source dependencies for vulnerabilities and malware, and it detects hardcoded secrets.

howToUse.title: Triage findings
howToUse.description: Use the AI triage on the findings, then fix the ones that matter. The free edition adds cross-file analysis for small teams.

howToUse.title: Moving from another scanner
howToUse.description: If the team is moving from Checkmarx or Snyk, read the Shift programme on the page.
